title: How Tea Travelled The World
titleZh: 茶叶是如何走向世界的
lead: Follow the long timeline to see how a leaf from mountain gardens became a shared ritual in ports, cities, and homes around the world.
leadZh: 沿着这条长时间线，看看一片来自山地茶园的叶子，如何成为港口、城市与家庭共同的日常仪式。

image.caption: 雾气中的山地茶园，连绵的种植带见证了茶叶走向世界。
image.captionZh: 山地茶园连接着遥远的港口、城市与日常茶杯。

events.title: The Legend Of Shennong And Tea
events.lead: An ancient legend places the discovery of tea deep in China’s past, giving the leaf a cultural origin story that would be retold for centuries.
events.leadZh: 古老传说把茶的发现放在中国遥远的过去，这一起源故事在漫长岁月中不断被讲述。

events.title: Tea Appears In Written Records
events.titleZh: 茶开始出现在文字记载中
events.lead: Written references show tea moving beyond a local plant and into the recorded life of courts, markets, and travelers.
events.leadZh: 文字记载显示，茶逐渐超越地方植物的身份，进入宫廷、市集与旅人的生活。

events.title: Tang Tea Culture Takes Root
events.lead: Tea moves from regional habit to a shared cultural practice. Markets and poems carry its language across China.
events.leadZh: 茶从地域性饮用习惯变成共同的文化实践，市集与诗歌让茶的语言广泛传播。

events.title: The Classic Of Tea Is Written
events.lead: Lu Yu’s writing gathers cultivation, preparation, utensils, and taste into a systematic account of tea culture.
events.leadZh: 陆羽的著述将种植、制作、器具和品饮汇集成系统的茶文化记录。

events.title: Tea Reaches Japan
events.lead: Monks and envoys return from China with tea seeds and preparation methods. Tea begins a new life across the sea.
events.leadZh: 僧侣与使者从中国带回茶种和制茶方法，茶在海的另一边开始新的旅程。

events.title: Tea Becomes A Ritual
events.lead: Tea preparation becomes a refined social ritual. The cup is no longer only a drink; it becomes a way to host and contemplate.
events.leadZh: 制茶逐渐成为精致的社交仪式，茶杯不再只是饮品，也是待客与沉思的方式。

events.title: Loose-Leaf Tea Transforms Brewing
events.lead: A shift away from compressed tea changes utensils and preparation, shaping many familiar brewing practices.
events.leadZh: 从紧压茶转向散茶改变了器具与制作方式，并塑造了今日熟悉的冲泡习惯。

events.title: Chinese Tea Arrives In Amsterdam
events.titleZh: 中国茶叶抵达阿姆斯特丹
events.lead: Dutch merchants bring small chests of Chinese tea to Amsterdam. The unfamiliar leaves attract curiosity in European ports.
events.leadZh: 荷兰商人把几箱中国茶带到阿姆斯特丹，这种陌生的叶子很快在欧洲港口引起好奇。

events.title: Tea Enters The British Court
events.lead: Court fashion gives tea new visibility in Britain, and demand begins spreading through elite households and city merchants.
events.leadZh: 宫廷时尚让茶在英国获得新的关注，需求开始在上层家庭与城市商人中扩散。

events.title: Tea And The Boston Protest
events.lead: Tea becomes bound to taxation, trade, and political protest, showing how a daily drink can carry global power.
events.leadZh: 茶与税收、贸易和政治抗议紧密相连，一杯日常饮品也承载着全球权力。

events.title: The East India Company Begins Tea Cultivation In Assam
events.titleZh: 东印度公司在阿萨姆开始种植茶叶
events.lead: As demand grows in Britain, experimental gardens in Assam take root and a new global tea route begins to form.
events.leadZh: 随着英国饮茶需求增长，阿萨姆的试验茶园扎根，一条新的全球茶叶路线由此形成。

events.title: The Suez Canal Shortens The Route
events.lead: The new canal shortens voyages between Asian ports and Europe, changing the speed and economics of the tea trade.
events.leadZh: 新运河缩短了亚洲港口与欧洲之间的航程，改变了茶叶贸易的速度与成本。

events.title: Tea Becomes A Global Ritual
events.titleZh: 茶叶成为全球性的日常仪式
events.lead: Railways, steamships, and city tea rooms bring tea to a larger public. A former luxury becomes an everyday cup.
events.leadZh: 铁路、轮船和城市茶室把茶带给更广泛的人群，曾经的奢侈品逐渐成为日常一杯。

events.title: The Tea Bag Enters Daily Life
events.lead: Convenient packets make tea easier to brew in offices and homes, balancing speed with older traditions.
events.leadZh: 方便的茶包让办公室与家庭泡茶更轻松，在效率与传统之间寻找平衡。

events.title: New Tea Regions Grow Rapidly
events.lead: Production expands in East Africa and other regions, adding new origins to an already global supply chain.
events.leadZh: 东非等地的产量快速增长，为已经全球化的供应链增添新的产地。

events.title: Bubble Tea Reimagines The Cup
events.titleZh: 珍珠奶茶重新想象茶杯
events.lead: A playful new format travels from Taiwan to cities worldwide, demonstrating how quickly tea culture can reinvent itself.
events.leadZh: 一种新的趣味形式从台湾走向世界城市，展现茶文化如何迅速自我更新。

events.title: Tea Is Reimagined By New Generations
events.titleZh: 新一代人重新想象一杯茶
events.lead: Small growers, new cafés, and digital communities bring attention back to origin, process, and people.
events.leadZh: 小型种植者、新式茶馆和数字社区重新关注产地、工艺与人。
